findings.title: shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators now gates return null, affecting non-passkey subclasses
findings.body: fillContextForm now returns null (causing required-action registration flow) based on shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators(context) instead of simply user != null. For WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator this method is overridden to return false, meaning authenticators.getAuthenticators().isEmpty() check and the early `return null` path is skipped entirely for conditional UI, changing behavior silently for any caller relying on the previous `user != null` short-circuit (e.g. second-factor WebAuthnAuthenticator subclasses that don't override the method but have different expectations). This behavioral change isn't covered by any non-webauthn unit tests.

findings.title: fillContextForm only called when context.getUser()==null branch previously, now also for pre-set user with wrong condition ordering
findings.body: The webauthn fillContextForm call was moved outside of the `else` block and is now gated solely by isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()), which runs regardless of whether formData was already populated with loginHint/rememberMe values. This changes the order/conditions under which fillContextForm executes compared to the original code and may call fillContextForm even when the user was already set via USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH note, which previously used a different helper form.setAttribute block; the two concerns (hiding username field vs showing webauthn fields) are no longer mutually tied, risking inconsistent form state for re-authentication (e.g. passkeys icon shown with username hidden fields in unexpected combos). Needs explicit test coverage for the combination of USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH + conditional passkeys to confirm correct form rendering.

findings.title: Visibility of USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH widened from protected to public
findings.body: The authentication note constant was made public to allow access from AuthenticatorUtils, widening the API surface of this abstract class. This is a minor API contract change; if this field is intended to remain internal to authenticators, consider moving the constant to a shared location instead of exposing it as public API, which could be depended upon by external SPI implementations now that it's public, complicating future refactors.
